lessons.applicability: Use a union only for real, nonoverlapping phases. DFB8's header/length/destination phases change allocation; its independent-local control differs. Squad1237F0's shared result assignment changes fallback priority; a descriptor/result union then restores S1 and the annulled zero write but leaves unit/code swapped. Read both controls before transferring either effect. These are pinned source contexts, not original-field meanings or a universal union recipe.

In ADF0, assigning the masked item to an SI word before setup calls creates a measured call-crossing lifetime and saved-register allocation, while final assembly places the mask later. Preserve the separately stored full word and real consumers. A narrow local or normalization after the calls is a different hypothesis. The preserved source still has prologue/loop differences; this does not identify original C or a universal allocation rule.

ADF0's real delimiter branches preserve two stores/limit tests through allocation before late merging. D14C's selective transfer of the shared emission into existing mode4/mode3 default arms, retaining enclosing stores, removes 68 word differences; broader earlier expansions used a different context. Compare exact source pairs and receiver evidence; preserve actual operations without dummy work. Neither case identifies original C. Private equality still requires complete-wave gates.

Retaining the real incoming word amount across a lookup for a new-slot update transferred from B63C to B4C4. The first B4C4 candidate preserved both record scans and matched instruction fields outside actual relocations. Inspect both source contexts, retain the original truncation and memory operations, and reconcile caller widths separately. These are provisional native observations, not canonical linked or whole-wave acceptance.

B710's explicit increment alternatives and branch-local byte conversions change temporary registers; preserve clamps, reads and call width. In LZSS A510, signed char/short leading fill stores assigned -1 reuse the full-width sentinel and restore the shared-tail jump (1748 to 1744 bytes). Unsigned -1 alone is object-identical to the unsigned FF/FFFF control. These source pairs are context-bound diagnostics; complete-owner acceptance is separate.

Replacing named slot pointers with direct array reads and writes in guarded nested loops restored the outer cursor and inner snapshot, reducing this source pair from 48 to 18 differing words. A separate named-pointer dump rejects a hoisted address's induction reduction; its user-variable copy cost supports a bounded explanation. This is source-bound evidence, not the winning source's internal pass trace. Preserve genuine accesses; never add dummy consumers.

123458's real X/Z phases change F0/F2; its four-division counterexample shares only at JUMP2, and block scope does not force local allocation. In 1284C4, the completed 1/256 scale then first lower bound retain two SETs and select F4; first-grid-scale and two-unit controls retain SETs but choose F8/F2. Preserve actual operations and widths; check surviving definitions and interference. These source-bound pairs establish no general allocation rule or original C.

Preserve actual producers and call arguments. Shop977E0's cursor/value precursor changes A0/V1 preferences but retains an address bug. In Squad1237F0, A0 preference alone still leaves pointer captures in A0 and adds shuffles; direct consumption by actual evaluator calls adds hard-A0 conflicts, placing pointers in A1 and conditions in A0. The final source also depends on prior result/storage corrections. Compare the exact source/probe pair; no general coalescing or original-C claim follows.

Equivalent minimum conditionals can preserve every relocation-masked instruction field while exchanging the external objects loaded. In this source pair, reversing the comparison and matching result arms restored actual address bindings without changing text extent or table bytes. Check real symbols and implicit addends; field agreement alone is insufficient. The earlier source remains a counterexample. This is bounded source evidence, not a general operand-order rule.

Separate genuine definitions of one argument in existing paths can prevent loop hoisting. In this clean nonmatching example, RTL/LOOP/FLOW retain four definitions; allocation then selects the wrong register and delay filling duplicates the constants into unwanted slots. The overall candidate regresses despite resolving hoisting. Preserve actual calls, producers and path behavior; do not invent assignments or consumers. Stage progress alone does not select a best candidate or establish transfer.

Compare genuine array-member indexing or a local indexed address with assignment to a shared cursor. In this clean nonmatching context, the shared cursor retained an extra saved-register copy; direct member indexing equaled the local form and restored the aggregate base plus member displacement. Source-bound loop dumps explain the terminal induction reduction. Preserve actual layout, bounds and operation order; the counterexample does not isolate an allocation stage or prove general transfer.

Equivalent real loop guards can retain different compiler comparison pseudos. In this clean nonmatching pair, index<count survives FLOW, becomes a USE in COMBINE and receives an eight-byte slot during allocation; count>0 loses it and shrinks the frame. Inspect source-bound stages before inferring a missing field. Preserve real index/bound producers, widths and zero-iteration behavior; never manufacture references or padding. Transfer and whole-function acceptance remain unproved.

Real arithmetic tails can merge after allocation. In D14C, 004F corrects 8CD6: division 762 and store 4772 both disappear at late-jump; equivalent 776 remains. Best 718B already has two C divisions that merge late. Extended-arm controls retain duplicate divisions when live successors prevent tail comparison. Preserve real operands and follow the full emitted allocation range. These nonmatching examples establish candidate behavior, not retail history or a universal recipe.

Allocation starts before delay filling. D14C's guard-local controls remain nonmatching; the resource-context branch-local index restores 428 bytes versus early-index 424. In LZSS AC0C, branch-local promoted byte/offset, shifts through existing len and decoded-word/working-byte separation remove 16 nonrelocated differences at 804 bytes. Preserve real consumers, widths and guards. These context-bound research pairs are not complete-owner acceptance or universal register recipes.

If a real pointer disappears into a biased induction variable, inspect loop-pass combination and profitability. Moving its genuine increment into existing alternative paths prevented reduction in this clean nonmatching example and restored base-plus-field addressing. Preserve one increment per original path and operation order. Baseline evidence is native-only; stage facts belong to the changed source. Final tail merging and other registers remain unresolved; this is not a general rule.

Real producer/use phases can affect allocation. Shop 994B4 X/Y phases fold in combine. EBBC's single-pass quotient loop retains notes and later load dependencies; removing only the loop leaves 33 word differences. D14C's DA2A emission loop retains FLOW notes and raises reference weight but leaves all native bytes and 68 differences unchanged. Inspect the receiver's stages: notes or weights alone establish neither a desired reload choice nor original macro identity. Wave acceptance is separate.

Real raw-mode-byte and normalized-flag phases restore mode/readiness S4/S5 without moving initialization (457). Earlier-zero control B834 restores those homes but puts the zero at the wrong site; 5E is the unchanged control. Counts, ordering and homes are measured; priority ratios are explanatory, not traced allocation decisions. Preserve genuine reads and consumers, inspect full allocation/placement, and retain unresolved terminal sharing. All examples remain nonmatching.

For a single-set unsigned numerator, inspect equivalent side-effect-free comparisons and destination propagation. The cited trace shows quotient/remainder allocation and reciprocal scheduling changes; inspect named-destination and first-operand counterexamples. These nonmatching contexts contain inherited artificial filter references, ineligible for final source. The measured component effect requires replay without those references; it is not an accepted match or general operand-order recipe.

Sharing a real case/default body changed early and distant reload choices; late merging can hide an earlier allocated producer. Preserve the switch mapping. The earlier trace and direct-pair parent have distinct identities. These nonmatching contexts contain inherited artificial filter references, ineligible for final source. Replay the component without them before relying on transfer; this is neither a universal parity rule nor evidence of retail's original source.

For the evidenced allocator-result/owner-load ordering conflict, inspect identical arms containing the real clear, copy and saved-byte load. The low-bit form transferred between two Actor functions; a full-null condition specializes an argument, and CF0's first site changes other registers. Preserve complete behavior; no pointer-bit meaning or exact compiler-pass mechanism is established.

Compare the coupled word-element spelling of a real clear and direct owner argument after allocation. The source form transferred from 159D0 to CF0's first site, while its second site needed the distinct duplication form. Neither component alone nor the proposed memory-class/pass mechanism is established by these observations; compare the complete source pairs.

Historical source-context lead only: the observation's canonical-source reference has drifted, so it is excluded from authenticated curated observations. Its archived source pair remains recoverable. For repeated constructor sites with verified coverage, compare per-site single-set locals against genuine loaded values shared across sites; this is not a universal allocator recipe.

When a real classifier result becomes a Boolean-to-index expression instead of the observed branch, inspect the separate word result and narrowed byte index. Preserve actual uses; do not introduce dummy carriers or infer original types.

Check CFG, widths and ABI before lifetimes. DMA1A380 keeps a real chunk live across the call; DE50 restricts its copy cursor to the small branch. Arena-register returning the slot already present in retail v0 keeps it live through the tail and resolves allocation; the void-return control differs. Read the source pairs and final wave records. These are source-shape observations, not proof of intended return semantics or a universal register preference.

In accepted callback walk 5058, qualifying both the genuine scratch callback field and fixed external byte access as volatile preserves callback-store-before-byte-read order; either qualifier alone and the unqualified control do not. This pinned-KMC result concerns two real accesses. It does not establish MMIO, original volatile declarations, a general alias rule, or permission to reorder accesses. Compare the legacy retained-early-load note for the opposite load-before-store shape.

Check ABI entry stores before inferring locals. KMC legacy ellipsis/next-argument traversal preserves pre-frame stores; an extra cursor word skips an argument despite unchanged extent. In the command dispatcher, an early first-word local moves the root load behind frame setup and adds four bytes; direct lookup restores its 28-byte prefix and 652-byte owner. Preserve real consumption. These source-context pairs and the nonmatching aggregate example are leads; final wave proof remains separate.

Use instruction-supported widths, branch targets and grouping before allocator tuning. In BC8C, a Boolean-result first guard preserves a repeated null guard through first CSE; moving the genuine byte clear before the repeat restores the delay-slot shape. Compare the simpler guarded-call control, which loses the repeat. This is source-context evidence, not a universal recipe; check exact source pairs and production binding separately.

Compare real initialization and expression placement. Realloc's earlier header pointer plus folded endpoints restores mask/load order; rebuild's record stride before its root cursor restores initialization order. Scan's miss-path increment and size-parameter reuse restore scheduling/registers. Preserve actual operations. Private source pairs are diagnostic; the full wave record supplies production acceptance. These effects are context-specific.

Supported symbols can alter address materialization. In 2215D0, a real-phase unsigned word identity folds in combine but changes address-reference priority, restoring ADDIU and S7/S8. D14C's B30D direct-callee form folds to the original call before allocation; native bytes remain unchanged. Distinguish stored-address lifetime from direct calls; preserve real values and signatures without invented callbacks or symbols. Examples do not establish linked or full-wave acceptance.

Reconcile joins and real lifetimes. Decoder failure-path layout changes return merging; evidenced address forms and the real U marker affect allocation/frame shape. Validator's actual failure-block placement changes first-CSE read availability in the same ordinary-static source context; compare both observations before transfer. W8/decoder references retain historical bindings; their wave records supply acceptance. Neither example establishes original C or a universal layout rule.
